column3: Locked attendance day cannot be corrected by HR (423). Backend override with reason added (task 234); clear message and shift-edit warning pending (task 235). Day also auto-locks after the regularization window.
Present day with no clock-out shows Attendance 0% and Worked hours '-' with no hint in the Day panel (task 236).
Late is counted independently of status: Absent + Late, and late days can exceed present days.
Punctuality denominator differs from Present count (28 of 50 on time vs 49 Present).
Attendance department filter lists 14 options for 9 departments (duplicate department rows).
New shift Save does nothing: overtime defaults fail validation and the error is hidden in a collapsed section.
Roster 'Shifts this week' counts OFF days as shifts (402 + 154 = 556).
Roster shows '-' for most days with a shift on one day only (single-day assignments from cell clicks).
Shift form 'inherited' full/half-day label does not match the backend default (8.5h / 4.5h); Override sends 0 and does nothing.
New-shift form defaults (flexible, no grace) differ from API defaults (not flexible, grace 0).
My Leave balance bar is misleading: 'Entitled' shows the balance cap, 'Accrued' folds in opening, carry-forward and adjustments, leave-year start hard-coded to 1-April.
Auto-approved leave does not rebuild attendance for the leave dates.
Probation / eligibility message has no date and ignores applicable-after-days when a probation end date is set.
Seed leave types have future effective dates (COF 08-Dec-26, SICK 18-Sep-26), blocking them.
Leave types exist (SICK, EL, ML, PL, COF) but no policy rule credits them; only Casual Leave works (task 194 pending).
Holiday admin 'Remote Work' location filter shows 0 and hides org-wide holidays.
Location holiday calendar replaces org-wide holidays instead of adding to them, so national holidays can be lost for employees with a location calendar.
Holiday type chips act as hide toggles and the stat cards ignore them.
Holiday resolver logic is duplicated in three places; the attendance copy ignores archived rows.
